proposals.title: App library
proposals.summary: A spacious grid with search; the simplest way to see every app at once.
proposals.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one high-fidelity launcher proposal board for Inner Breeze (Inbe), landscape 16:10 composition.
Primary request: design a clean, modern, easy-to-use app launcher INSIDE Inbe that replaces a crowded navigation bar. Show a large Android phone view on the left and the corresponding large desktop view on the right. Flat straight-on UI, no perspective, no hands, no photography. Generous breathing room, polished product design, readable human-sized typography with Android/system sans serif styling. Use restrained thin outline icons, consistent icon stroke weight, large touch targets and simple interaction cues. The desktop must be the same navigation concept adapted to a wide window, not an unrelated website.
App inventory: five feature apps named exactly "Lists", "Habits", "Practice", "Diary", "Lumi". "Profile" and "Settings" are persistent utility destinations, visually subordinate to those five apps. Profile leads to the existing Account, Data, Friends and Leaderboard destinations; do not depict those as newly installed apps. Show all five apps in the launcher, not just a subset. Inbe's Lumi glyph should be a small outlined firefly, not a star or generic sparkle.
Constraints: clear hierarchy, no crowded permanent navigation, no fabricated additional apps, no notifications, no app store, no install/uninstall controls. These are launcher mockups for existing apps. No decorative hero photography, no mascot illustration, no rainbow icon pack, no blurred text, no illegible microcopy, no random filler, no watermarks. A small "Inbe" wordmark is sufficient; do not invent a brand logo. Keep all text crisp and spelled correctly. The phone should occupy roughly one third of the image and desktop two thirds, both large enough for legible labels. Use minimal annotation outside the interfaces.
Concept 01: "App library". Full-page launcher. Board heading exactly "01 · App library" with one short subtitle "Every app, one calm place".
Visual direction: warm ivory canvas, pale stone surfaces, deep charcoal type, muted blue accent, subtle borders and almost no shadows. Quiet contemporary wellbeing/productivity interface.
Phone: header "Inbe" and small profile circle; page title "Apps"; rounded search field "Find an app"; five large accessible cards in a two-column grid: "Lists" with a checklist icon, "Habits" with a checkmark-in-circle icon, "Practice" with a breathing/wave icon, "Diary" with a book icon, and a full-width "Lumi" card with firefly outline icon. Each card has a tiny consistent pastel icon tile, app name and concise supporting text respectively "Organize your day", "Build your routine", "Breathe and move", "Write and reflect", "Your companion". Under the grid, a quiet utility row "Profile" and "Settings". Bottom navigation contains just "Apps", "Habits", "Practice", with Apps active and the other two representing pinned favorites; no other tabs.
Desktop: short top header "Inbe" with the "Apps" control active and small "Profile" and "Settings" controls on the far right. In the content area a title "Apps", same search field, and five equally sized cards in a generous three-column grid, the remaining two on the next row. Same exact app names, glyphs and supporting text. A restrained secondary action "Edit favorites". Do not fill unused space with dashboard data.
Composition: clear large app grid is the hero on both screen sizes. All five apps and both utility destinations must be visible.

Concept 02: "Quick switch". An on-demand app switcher over the current app, keeping the current page uncluttered. Board heading exactly "02 · Quick switch" with short subtitle "Switch without losing your place".
Visual direction: bright off-white with clean white panels, deep slate text, restrained cobalt-blue selection, one soft shadow on the switcher, subtle translucent dimming of the page behind it. Precise native-feeling UI rather than excessive glassmorphism.
Phone: show a partially visible "Practice" page behind an open large rounded bottom sheet that reaches nearly to the top. The page header has a compact grid icon control "Apps" and current destination "Practice". The sheet is titled "Apps", with a small close X and search field "Find an app". Two modest favorites chips under "Favorites": "Habits" and "Practice". Under "All apps", show FIVE large tidy rows exactly "Diary", "Habits", "Lists", "Lumi", "Practice", each with a distinctive monochrome outline icon and a subtle chevron. Practice has a light blue active background and a small "Current" label. Footer has subdued "Profile" and "Settings" shortcuts. The launcher sheet must dominate the phone and all five apps fit visibly.
Desktop: show a quiet Practice workspace with a breathing ring, title "Practice", and a minimal top bar with a left grid icon "Apps" control. A substantial 420px-style anchored rounded popover is open below this Apps control. Popover reproduces the same searchable favorites plus alphabetic five-row "All apps" list, active Practice row, Profile and Settings footer. The switcher must be large, central enough to read, and visibly anchored to the Apps control; the remaining Practice page stays visible. No permanent left sidebar, no permanent bar full of app tabs.
Composition: show that selecting an app takes one click from the Apps menu; do not draw arrows or explanatory paragraphs.

Concept 03: "Favorites dock". A small personal dock for frequent apps, paired with an open app library drawer. Board heading exactly "03 · Favorites dock" with short subtitle "Your essentials stay close".
Visual direction: a sophisticated dark mode, deep blue-charcoal background, slightly lighter slate cards, warm white text, muted mint selection. High contrast readable text; controlled soft borders; no neon, no futuristic glow.
Phone: title "Apps" beneath small "Inbe". Search "Find an app". A "Favorites" section containing two large chips "Habits" and "Practice" with small pin icons. Below, "All apps" is a two-column icon grid showing exactly "Lists", "Habits", "Practice", "Diary", "Lumi", each as a roomy rounded tile. "Profile" and "Settings" appear in a quiet footer row. Persistent bottom dock has only three items "Habits", "Practice", "Apps"; Apps selected in muted mint. No other bottom navigation. A small action "Edit favorites" at the top of the Favorites section suggests customization.
Desktop: a very slim 80px-style navigation rail with a small Inbe mark, labeled outline buttons "Habits", "Practice", and "Apps", Apps selected; a "Profile" icon near the bottom. Opening Apps reveals a full-height drawer immediately alongside the rail, occupying about 45 percent of the desktop view, with title "Apps", search, the same two Favorites, and an alphabetic ALL apps list containing "Diary", "Habits", "Lists", "Lumi", "Practice". Put "Settings" in the drawer footer. To the right, show a restrained Practice page with a centered breathing circle and simple start control. This is not two competing large sidebars: one narrow dock and one temporary app drawer.
Composition: drawer and phone launcher content stay prominent and readable; prioritize the visible app choices and the very small permanent dock.

Concept 04: "Grouped spaces". A purpose-grouped library rather than a conventional icon grid. Board heading exactly "04 · Grouped spaces" with short subtitle "Choose by what you want to do".
Visual direction: warm white background, forest-green accent, charcoal text, pale sage selection and slim warm-gray separators. Editorial clarity, beautifully aligned text, generous spacing; simple white surfaces with restrained rounded corners.
Phone: compact "Inbe" header, page title "Apps", search field "Find an app". Then stacked clean sections with small quiet uppercase section headings. "EVERYDAY" contains two large tappable rows "Lists" and "Habits" with checklist and circular-check outline icons. "WELLBEING" contains "Practice" and "Lumi" with wave and firefly outline icons. "REFLECTION" contains "Diary" with a book outline icon. Each row has a short simple description beneath the name and a chevron. After these, a thin divider and small utility destinations "Profile" and "Settings". The footer has a compact single centered pill grid icon plus "Apps", active, acting as the shared app switcher; no overflowing nav list.
Desktop: a compact top bar "Inbe", one grid icon "Apps" button and a profile circle. Main heading "Apps" and wide search field. Below, three spacious group columns titled "Everyday", "Wellbeing", "Reflection". Everyday contains large row cards "Lists" and "Habits", Wellbeing "Practice" and "Lumi", Reflection "Diary". All use the same simple outline icon language and one-line app description. "Profile" and "Settings" are subdued utility links at the bottom right. Use whitespace intentionally and show the five actual apps only; do not add placeholder tiles.
Composition: purposeful category headings and easy-to-scan app rows are the hero. Looks simple and immediately usable on mobile and desktop.
